links.surface: عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ

notes: the reporter says «سألته عن الملكين» and the answer is given with only the blessing «ع», so the Imam who answers is not named in the words; whether that is a missing link or the pronoun for the last link is not settled, so I left no link after عبد الله بن موسى بن جعفر
«أبي رحمه الله» is the compiler's father, a bare relation
